items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: First I played with my brother. But that was just very irregular.

ctx.x: I see. I don't know, I keep jumping around from one thing to another and asking about it. But what was your first band you played with?

Oh, that was another band. First I played with my brother. But that was just very irregular. No, just now and then I mean. Did the band have a name? No, I guess they had a name. When I came in my brother almost quit playing already. So he just played a few jobs that came up with friends, more private jobs. Then I used to go with them and play band with him. Then I played with a band called the Snakes or something like that. I don't remember. I think it was the Snakes. That was a modern Dixland band. Some of the…
And then who is your own personal favorite, influences?
